pages.title: Another Kind of Fire
pages.text: The Clibano handles dual-input processing, alloys and residues. It is essential for sustained Obsidiansteel and Soul production. Build its shell, then awaken the core with Mundabitur Dust.

pages.title: Prepare the Shell
pages.text: Gather 8 Polished Darkstone, 17 Polished Darkstone Bricks, a Clibano Core and Mundabitur Dust. Build a 3x3x3 shell with an empty center. Put the core in the middle of one side.

pages.name: Clibano Blueprint
pages.text: Use Mundabitur Dust on the core. The inner center must be air.

pages.title: Feed the Fire
pages.text: Insert fuel and ingredients, and leave room for products and residues. The soul slot controls speed and eligibility for certain recipes; the enhancer slot enables special recipes such as alloys.
